name: Maitha

skills.name: Powerful Attack
skills.description: (Basic Attack) Deals 110% Physical DMG. Melee range 1-1.

skills.name: Block and Counter
skills.description: (Reaction) When receiving a melee attack from the front or side, 100% chance to trigger Block. Leads to Strike Back with basic attack dealing 70% physical DMG. 1 time per round.

skills.name: Come On, Everybody!
skills.description: (Support) Restores 20% HP and grants ATK I and P.DEF I to all allies within 3 tiles. Takes physical attacks from the enemy for allies within 2 tiles for 2 turns.

skills.name: Maitha's Combo
skills.description: (Physical DMG) Deals 20% DMG 1 time, 50% DMG 3 times, and knocks the target back by 2 tiles. Melee range 1-1.

skills.name: Maitha's Charge
skills.description: (Physical DMG) Charges at 1 enemy within a cross-shaped range, dealing 130% DMG and knocking the target back by 2 tiles. Range 1-3.

summary: Starter Defender captured from live client on Pixel 7. Skill tooltips include NRG/CD for class skills.
howToUse: Open with Come On, Everybody! for party sustain/buffs; use Combo/Charge for chip and knockback.
